payload.title: libvips is the image engine, GD the fallback
payload.context: Images (#25): GD drops colour profiles without converting, so wide-gamut photos were stored duller and CMYK came out wrong. The owner chose libvips on 2026-11-27.
payload.rationale: libvips converts with the embedded profile. GD is kept, selectable by NOONGUN_MEDIA_ENGINE, for an image without libvips. Both engines share EncodingRules and the same tests.
payload.consequences: The app image grows by about 61 MB. The health check fails when the configured engine is missing. Images already stored are not reprocessed. The web container needs about 1 GB for images with two slots.
